fusions.name: Fowler's Lob
fusions.desc: A gliding throw that deals 4 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Flush the Covey
fusions.desc: Snaps a mesh open around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and throwing them back 2 tiles. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Updraft
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh up into the wind and rides it forward, carrying you 5 tiles at once.

fusions.name: Momentum of the Glide
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
